articles.title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
articles.description: German authorities seize dinghies and life jackets during their first raids under a new law that cracks down on smuggling.

articles.title: Russia warns UK over supplying drones to Ukraine
articles.description: An MoD spokesperson responds by saying Britain stands "shoulder to shoulder" with Ukraine.

articles.title: Russia's prominent anti-war politician jailed for 11 years
articles.description: Lev Schlosberg is found guilty of "discrediting" Russia's army - a verdict he condemns as punishment for his political position.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
articles.description: Moscow says nine people have been killed in the past 24 hours, while Kyiv reports four deaths.

articles.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
articles.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

articles.title: US tourist killed by lightning strike on Mount Etna during hike in restricted area
articles.description: An American tourist has been killed by a lightning strike after hiking in a restricted part of Mount Etna.

articles.title: Trump downscales 'hostile' military drills with South Korea
articles.description: Joint US military exercises with South Korea will be downscaled, Donald Trump says, as they are "hostile" and too expensive.
